title: Nutty Soft Ukrainian Pork Dumplings
description: A fresh and pillowy Ukrainian dish featuring pork and nuts, perfect for a date night, made with canola oil and a deglaze for a low-fat friendly meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, chopped walnuts, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and egg, and then add this mixture to the pork mixture, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 20 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, and then use a fork to crimp the edges.
Heat the canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat, and then add the dumplings, being careful not to overcrowd the skillet.
Cook the dumplings for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the dumplings from the skillet, and then deglaze the skillet with the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Serve the dumplings hot, with the deglazed sauce spooned over the top.
